title: Compatibility of the derived scalar-extension adjunction with homotopy Hom representatives
statement: Under the general-site sheafification hypotheses and selected unbounded derived categories of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], fix a ring-sheaf map phi, its exact restriction F [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], an additive functor E presenting sheafified scalar extension [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] with its prescribed object and map equations, and an adjunction a:E ⊣ F. For every universal left derived pair (LF,epsilon) of E_h followed by Qh [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], there exists d:LF ⊣ F_D such that, for every pair of homotopy objects M,N and f:E_h(M)->N, d.homEquiv(epsilon_M followed by Qh(f)) equals Qh(a_h.homEquiv(f)) followed by the inverse component at N of the canonical exact-functor factorization F_D.

source.place: Tags 09T5 and 0FND, together with sites-cohomology.tex Tags 06YY and 07A6; parent Steps 3–4

proof.text: The prescribed object and map equations identify E with the functor supplied by derivedChangeOfRingsIndependentCoefficients, by Functor.ext. Use its preservation of quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes. Every homotopy object has a K-flat resolution; lift homotopy maps through the full quotient to apply this preservation. Resolving-class essential constancy therefore supplies the incoming pro-diagram values.

The quasi-isomorphism fraction calculus makes each outgoing denominator category filtered. For the localized termwise exact restriction U, use inverse U(s) as the cocone leg at a denominator s, with identity denominator and identity section. Functoriality proves naturality and the split factorization criterion explicitly. The canonical exact restriction factorization proves U inverts quasi-isomorphisms and identifies the right derived comparison with mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.

Apply exists_derived_adjunction_compatibility to these essentially constant systems, the supplied left derived pair, the ordinary adjunction and exact restriction with its canonical factorization. This gives both the adjunction and precisely the representative Hom identity asserted.

theorem sheafRingDerivedHomComparison (φ : O ⟶ O')
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J O))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J O'))]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (restrictScalars
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).map φ))]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (restrictScalars
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).map φ))]
    (E : SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J O) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J O'))
    (h : ∀ M, E.obj M = changeOfRings φ M)
    (hm : ∀ {M N} (f : M ⟶ N), E.map f =
      eqToHom (h M) ≫ changeOfRingsHom φ M f ≫ eqToHom (h N).symm)
    [E.Additive]
    (a : E ⊣ restrictScalars
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).map φ))
    (LF : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{r}
        (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J O)) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{r} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J O')))
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ LF ⟶
      E.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (hLF : LF.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{r}
        (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J O)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) :
    ∃ d : LF ⊣ (restrictScalars
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).map φ)).mapDerivedCategory,
      (∀ (M : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{r}
          (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J O)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
        (N : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{r}
          (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J O')) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
        (f : (E.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M ⟶ N),
        d.homEquiv _ _ (ε.app M ≫ DerivedCategory.Qh.map f) =
          DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((a.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).homEquiv M N f) ≫
            (restrictScalars
              ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).map
                φ)).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app
              N)
